repo.name: django-rest-hoots-backend
repo.about: A two-day beginner lesson that builds a Django REST API for the Hoot React frontend.

microlessons.skill: Relate Express concepts to Django and read the Python used in the API.
microlessons.learningObjective: Explain the request path through a Django REST API and translate the Python syntax used in the lesson.

microlessons.skill: Create a virtual environment, Django project, app, and PostgreSQL connection.
microlessons.learningObjective: Set up and verify a Django REST Framework project connected to PostgreSQL.

microlessons.skill: Define related Django models and create database tables with migrations.
microlessons.learningObjective: Create Hoot and Comment models with user relationships and apply their migrations.

microlessons.skill: Use serializers to validate input and shape model data as frontend-compatible JSON.
microlessons.learningObjective: Build nested serializers that return the exact fields expected by the React frontend.

microlessons.skill: Create sign-up and sign-in endpoints and protect routes with Bearer tokens.
microlessons.learningObjective: Issue a frontend-compatible JWT and use it to authenticate protected requests.

microlessons.skill: Configure CORS and connect a Vite environment variable to Django.
microlessons.learningObjective: Run both applications and complete an authenticated request from React to Django.

microlessons.skill: Build explicit list, create, show, update, and delete route handlers.
microlessons.learningObjective: Implement and test all CRUD operations for Hoots with function-based DRF views.

microlessons.skill: Build nested comment routes and enforce author-only changes.
microlessons.learningObjective: Create, update, and delete comments while preventing users from changing another author's content.
